name: MarkaKalkan Public Lite Risk Scan Acquisition Worker - V1

parameters.content:
## HRT-MKT-TR-1D-3D-B4-B5 — INACTIVE ACQUISITION WORKER

This child workflow acknowledges a validated acquisition command with HTTP 202 before the long marketplace path. Acquisition execution and result callback remain disabled. Do not activate until inactive import, credential binding, backend deployment, reconciliation/redrive, index/TTL operationalization, and controlled live validation complete. Logical child identity is deterministic from handoffId.

## marketplaceLimited execution — disabled

Adapter: trendyol_public_listing_v1

Channel adapter result: risk-scan-public-lite-channel-adapter-result-v1

Public pages only. No authentication, cookies, API keys, CAPTCHA solving, or anti-bot bypass. The execution guard is false and the HTTP Request node is disabled.

## Result callback — disabled

Contract: risk-scan-public-lite-result-envelope-v1

Provider result: risk-scan-public-lite-provider-result-v1

Callback: https://europe-west3-markakalkan-app.cloudfunctions.net/receivePublicLiteRiskScanResult

Header: X-MarkaKalkan-Public-Lite-Result-Token

Only the assembled resultEnvelope may be sent after controlled live validation. No synthetic result or placeholder evidence may be sent.
